**

Star Pizza in Tirol

** Discover the authentic taste of **Tirol** with **Star Pizza**, where every slice is a celebration of regional flavors. Located in the heart of **Innsbruck**, this cozy pizzeria brings the warmth of **Tirol**’s alpine charm to your plate. Indulge in our signature **Tiroler Spezialitäten**—think crispy **Kaiserschmarrn** as a sweet topping or fresh **Speck** and **Käse** from local farms. Our wood-fired pizzas are crafted with love, using the finest ingredients sourced straight from **Tirol**’s valleys. Whether you’re craving a classic **Margherita** or a hearty **Tiroler Bauernpizza** loaded with **Obazda**, **Radieschen**, and **Bergkäse**, **Star Pizza** delivers a taste of home. Pair your meal with a cold **Tiroler Bier** or a glass of crisp **Grüner Veltliner** for the perfect alpine dining experience. Visit us in **Innsbruck** and let **Star Pizza** take you on a flavorful journey through **Tirol**—where every bite tells a story. **Come hungry, leave happy!**
